# Anubrat Sahoo - Developer Portfolio

This repository contains the source code for the personal developer portfolio of Anubrat Sahoo, a full-stack and Web3 engineer.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework:** React 19 + Vite
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 with custom CSS variables (`src/index.css`)
- **Typography:** IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono
- **Build Strategy:** Statically pre-rendered via a custom `prerender.js` script to improve initial load performance and SEO.

## Directory Structure
- `src/components/`: React components defining the portfolio sections.
  - `Hero.jsx`, `About.jsx`, `Skills.jsx`, `Exploring.jsx`: Minimalist presentation components.
  - `Projects.jsx`: Renders Web2 and Web3 projects inside highlighted, pop-out card containers with distinct SVG watermarks.
  - `PullRequests.jsx`: Dynamically fetches and renders recent GitHub PRs using the GitHub Search API.
  - `FAQ.jsx`: Uses an interactive accordion pattern for clean text-heavy rendering.
- `src/data/portfolio.js`: The central single source of truth for all portfolio content (projects, links, skills).
- `public/sitemap.xml`: SEO sitemap.
- `index.html`: The main entry point template.

## Design Philosophy & Conventions
- **Minimalist Aesthetic:** The UI mimics a clean "paper" document using a muted, earthy color palette defined in `index.css` (`--color-paper-bg: #faf7f0`).
- **Feature Highlighting:** Important content sections like Projects and Pull Requests use "pop-out" UI cards with subtle background SVG watermarks to break up scroll fatigue without breaking the minimalist aesthetic.
- **Responsiveness:** Outer and inner padding scales dynamically based on screen size to prevent UI clustering on mobile devices.

## Development Scripts
- `pnpm run dev`: Starts the Vite development server.
- `pnpm run build`: Bundles the React app and executes `prerender.js` for static generation.
- `pnpm run lint`: Runs ESLint over the project files.
